svg.title: The simulator loop
svg.desc: Claude Code drives a Unity Quest app running in editor Play Mode on the Meta XR Simulator. It injects head, controller and button input through the Meta XR Operator (MCP on port 8720), and reads the app's own state through DevRemote (HTTP on port 8731). Every check is ask, act, ask again, and each finding is pinned with a headless gate.
